summary: A horizontal or vertical divider, plain, or with a clickable icon or a text label in the middle.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A vertical rule for a row layout, like a button group. Applies to the `icon` and `label` forms too, which turn with it.

props.name: icon
props.description: Renders as a clickable button in the middle, sized & shaped to match. Wins over `label` if both are set.

props.name: onIconClick
props.description: Called when the icon button is pressed.

props.name: label
props.description: Renders as plain text in the middle. Ignored if `icon` is set.

props.name: iconShape
props.description: Corner radius on the icon button, which is the only part with corners. Only visible alongside `icon`.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
